svg.title: Data model of the AI Support Engineer
svg.desc: Six tables. A customer places many orders. An order contains many order items, each pointing at a product. An order is paid by many payments and is shipped as at most one shipment.
svg.text: Drawn from the real schema. created_at and updated_at exist on every table and are left out.
1 = exactly one N = many 0..1 = none or one PK = primary key FK = foreign key
